preserved_invariants: P15 lane B is TEST/EVIDENCE-ONLY: the frozen W0-W18 core and every merged productization wave (P0-P14) remain untouched — the dogfood consumes public exports only (packages/*, apps/*, infra/* read-only; no product source, manifest, spec or script is modified on this lane branch; pnpm-workspace.yaml unchanged — tests/* was already a workspace glob)

completion is granted ONLY by the independent evaluation suite (never the acting body's opinion): the acting body's self-certification is a typed INDEPENDENCE_DENIED pinned by test (flagship-journey.test.ts), a body-bound runtime verifier parks the journey with a typed ask and it never completes — bodies never self-certify

the user device is optional (P12 §7): the flagship journey completes with zero user-online ticks after kick-off; cloud bodies never depend on the user's computer being online; the disconnected-user timeline replays on return with exact revisions and retained uncertainty; presence is recorded, never consulted

honest outage statuses: a provider outage reads truthful UNAVAILABLE (typed window) with the lease SUSPECTED (UNKNOWN — never LOST without a verified failure, never fabricated liveness); no progress is fabricated during outage windows; bounded backoff then ASK — never an infinite loop; the outage window stays visible in the timeline and the evidence-only cost ledger

body replacement preserves semantic identity: the replacement inherits the task identity, authority context and the LAST durable verified checkpoint (fail-closed content-addressed integrity); the task record shows continuity (accumulated checkpoints and evidence), not a restart; killing a body does not lose the task

continuous observation works with ZERO bodies active (P7): events still ingest, System State stays truthful (FRESH/STALE/UNVERIFIED honest, never a fabricated success), nothing fabricates progress; a body is summoned only through the P9 action surface (authority-gated body-lifecycle with action-time re-evaluation, fail-closed typed denial)

exact-revision discipline: every journey asserts the P15 acceptance shape — exact-revision links across the repository (commits/push/PR), the runtime (workspace head), the deployment (sourceSha at the head) and the evidence graph (verdictRefs targeting the exact head); all unresolved uncertainty stays visible

zero external dependencies: the owned package uses workspace:* imports only + the existing toolchain (typescript ^5.5.0, vitest ^3.0.0, @types/node ^22.10.0); pnpm-lock.yaml and pnpm-workspace.yaml are byte-identical on the lane branch (the local install's importer refresh is reset before commit — no lockfile diff)

offline determinism: no ambient time, randomness, environment, network, processes or timers in the owned sources (every clock, store, seam, probe and outage window is injected); fixed vitest seed 424242; run-to-run identical results; no real GitHub API calls, no real body/reasoning providers, no real deployment targets, no network
